description: This file defines API endpoints related to booking and cancellation of classes in a gym management system. It includes data models, helper functions, and route handlers for creating and canceling bookings, with capacity enforcement and user authorization.

classes.name: BookingCreateRequest
classes.description: Data model for creating a booking, including class ID and optional member ID for admin bookings.

classes.name: BookingCancelRequest
classes.description: Data model for canceling a booking, including class ID.

methods.name: int _get_booked_count(db: Session, class_id: int)
methods.description: Helper to count active 'booked' bookings for a class.

methods.name: Classes _ensure_class_exists(db: Session, class_id: int)
methods.description: Helper to verify the existence of a class by ID.

methods.name: dict create_booking( payload: BookingCreateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new booking, with capacity check and duplicate prevention.

methods.name: dict cancel_booking( payload: BookingCancelRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: API endpoint to cancel an existing booking or cancel on behalf of a user if admin.

ctags.name: cancel_booking
ctags.signature: ( payload: BookingCancelRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.name: class_id
ctags.pattern: /^    class_id: int = Field(..., description="Class to book")$/

ctags.name: class_id
ctags.pattern: /^    class_id: int = Field(..., description="Class to cancel")$/

ctags.name: create_booking
ctags.signature: ( payload: BookingCreateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.pattern: /^    member_id: Optional[int] = Field(None, description="User ID to book for (admin only)")$/
